name: State That Executes Itself

authors.name: Operation Coinnectar Crew (HaxNation x FOSS Mumbai 2026)

description:
A vendored C library, state_serializer.c, parses a “lightweight binary state/config” format. The serializer looks harmless; the deserializer is the classic insecure-deserialization gadget.

One “application specific” field type is treated as a shell command and handed to a process-exec primitive. Identify the field type that triggers it and the exec wrapper used. Submit HXN{<magic_field_type_hex>_<exec_syscall>}.
hints: Walk the field loop in the deserializer. One type isn't data — it is built into a /bin/sh -c call and executed. The serializer never emits that type.
